title: Late Fee Amount under the LandlordGuard Fee Tariff
content:
**Tariff rule.** The LandlordGuard Dwelling Fire Policy late fee is the late-fee basis plus the late-fee adjustment, multiplied by the repeat factor, never below 0.00, rounded half-up to the cent once on the final figure. The standard late-fee basis is the tier's late fee, the standard late-fee adjustment is zero and the standard repeat factor is 1.

## Order of the arithmetic

1. The late-fee basis and the late-fee adjustment are added together.
2. That sum is multiplied by the repeat factor.
3. A result below 0.00 is taken as 0.00.
4. The result is rounded half-up to the cent; nothing is rounded before this point.

## Worked figures (hypothetical tier late fees)

| Tier's late fee taken as | Basis | Adjustment | Repeat factor | Late fee |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 10.00 USD | 10.00 | 0.00 | 1 | 10.00 USD |
| 5.00 USD | 5.00 | 0.00 | 1 | 5.00 USD |
